notablePrerequisites: Poison Dart Frog does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Poison Dart Frog's first ability by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Elsha of the Infinite's prowess ability and Valley Floodcaller trigger.
Resolve the Valley Floodcaller trigger, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve the Elsha of the Infinite trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
